hunks.baseline: The old man fell silent. In front of him, the three leaders and more than two hundred underlings knelt respectfully, watching his lips.
hunks.sol: The old man fell silent. In front of him, the three leaders and more than two hundred underlings knelt respectfully, hanging on his every word.

hunks.baseline: He had reached his limit. The curse of time could not be held back even by his two jiazi of internal energy, or by the manifested qi of a Supreme Peak master.
hunks.sol: He had reached his limit. The curse of time could not be held back even by his jiazi of internal energy,[^1] or by the mighty qi of a Supreme Peak master.

hunks.baseline: “Then why can’t you even lift this properly? Good grief. Watching you is making me frustrated.”
hunks.sol: “Then why can’t you even lift this properly? Ugh. I can’t stand watching this.”

hunks.baseline: “Don’t call me elder. Sit down and stop talking nonsense.”
hunks.sol: “Don’t ‘elder’ me. Sit down and stop talking nonsense.”

hunks.baseline: *Don’t say anything. If I put one foot wrong, he’ll kill me.*
hunks.sol: *Better not say a word. One wrong word and… we die.*

hunks.baseline: “I’ll pour you a drink, sir.”
hunks.sol: “I’ll pour you a drink.”

hunks.baseline: It was a sight difficult to witness even if one paid for it.
hunks.sol: It was a sight you’d struggle to see even if you paid gold for it.

hunks.baseline: “The one way you’re better than mounted bandits is that, even though you loot and kill, you aren’t arsonists who set fire to everything in sight. People who burn down other people’s homes deserve to be beaten to death!”
hunks.sol: “The one way you’re better than mounted bandits is that, even though you loot and kill, you aren’t arsonists who set fire to everything in sight. People who burn down other people’s homes deserve to be beaten to death, and even that wouldn’t be enough!”

hunks.baseline: What kind of circumstances could have driven an unidentified Supreme Peak master to search for someone personally? And in a body suffering from old age, no less.
hunks.sol: What kind of circumstances could have driven an unidentified peerless master to search for someone personally? And in a body suffering from old age, no less.

hunks.baseline: — Chinggen.
hunks.sol: —Hey, Chinggen.

hunks.baseline: — Are you listening? Answer me.
hunks.sol: —Are you listening? Answer me.

hunks.baseline: — Accept the old man’s offer. Quickly!
hunks.sol: —Accept the old man’s offer. Quickly!

hunks.baseline: — Impossible. I can’t find the person he wants. If we succeed, we may receive a great favor, but if we raise his hopes for nothing and fail, all we’ll gain is his resentment. I have no intention of dealing with that. Nor do I want to become more entangled with that old man.
hunks.sol: —Impossible. I can’t find the person he wants. If we succeed, we may receive a great favor, but if we raise his hopes for nothing and fail, all we’ll gain is his resentment. I have no intention of dealing with that. Nor do I want to become more entangled with that old man.

hunks.baseline: — Find him.
hunks.sol: —Find him.

hunks.baseline: — What?
hunks.sol: —What?

hunks.baseline: — If you find him, you can obtain the old man’s martial arts. Martial arts powerful enough to look down on the entire world!
hunks.sol: —If you find him, you can obtain the old man’s martial arts. Martial arts powerful enough to look down on the entire world!

hunks.baseline: — Are you insane? Greed has blinded you!
hunks.sol: —Are you insane? Greed has blinded you!

hunks.baseline: — No, it’s entirely possible. You’re too afraid of that old man to think it through.
hunks.sol: —No, it’s entirely possible. You’re too afraid of that old man to think it through.

hunks.baseline: — Don’t be ridiculous. Do you think he’ll fall for a threat like that? He’ll tear us apart before that happens!
hunks.sol: —Don’t be ridiculous. Do you think he’ll fall for a threat like that? He’ll tear us apart before that happens!

hunks.baseline: — He’s already an old man whose mind comes and goes because of his age. First, we search the surrounding area thoroughly and find the bastard, then we drag things out. Until the old man’s mind completely goes.
hunks.sol: —He’s already an old man whose mind comes and goes because of his age. First, we search the surrounding area thoroughly and find the bastard, then we drag things out. Until the old man’s mind completely goes.

hunks.baseline: They would wait for that moment, then subdue him. Through persuasion and threats, they would steal every bit of that powerful martial arts knowledge.
hunks.sol: They would wait for that moment, then subdue him. Through coaxing and threats, they would steal every bit of that powerful martial arts knowledge.

hunks.baseline: — What are you hesitating over? Accept already!
hunks.sol: —What are you hesitating over? Accept already!
[^1]: A *jiazi* is a traditional sixty-year cycle.
